title: AML Guardrail Definition
description: Compiled JSON payload for an AML guardrail definition (.guardrail.md). Validates that the compiled output conforms to the AML v1.3 specification.

spec_version.title: Spec Version
spec_version.description: AML format version. Must equal a platform-approved version string.

guardrail_id.title: Guardrail ID
guardrail_id.description: Stable, immutable identifier for this guardrail. Lowercase kebab-case. Immutable once referenced by any published agent definition.

version.title: Version
version.description: Semantic version of this guardrail definition. Increment whenever transport config or behavior changes.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state. active=usable; deprecated=usable but triggers lint warning on referencing agents; disabled=hard compile error on reference.

behaviour.title: Behaviour
behaviour.description: Declares what this guardrail does and what content it can process.

result_type.title: Result Type
result_type.description: Declares what kind of output this guardrail produces. score=returns a 0-10 severity integer; transform=returns modified content to replace the original; annotate=returns metadata tags added to the payload; enrich=returns content appended alongside the payload.

content_types.title: Content Types
content_types.description: Content modalities this guardrail is able to process. The runtime passes only parameters whose type matches an entry here. Attaching a guardrail to a position with no matching parameters is a hard compile error.

meta.title: Metadata
meta.description: Descriptive metadata for this guardrail. The description field is informational only and is never injected into the model's context.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the guardrail registry UI.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description of what this guardrail checks. Informational only — never sent to the model.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Team or individual responsible for maintaining this guardrail.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Searchable labels for discovery and filtering.

last_updated.title: Last Updated
last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the last update to this guardrail definition.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: Invocation details for external guardrails. Omit for built-in (in-process) guardrails. Allowed types: rest-api, lambda.

invocation.title: Invocation
invocation.description: Runtime invocation policy. Required when transport is present.

timeout_ms.title: Timeout ms
timeout_ms.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the transport response.

on_timeout.title: On Timeout
on_timeout.description: Synthetic severity returned to the agent if the call times out after retries. severity=10 is equivalent to fail_closed; severity=0 is equivalent to fail_open.

on_provider_error.title: On Provider Error
on_provider_error.description: Synthetic severity returned to the agent on a provider error (5xx, network failure) after retries.

max_attempts.title: Max Attempts
max_attempts.description: Total call attempts including the initial one.

backoff_ms.title: Backoff ms
backoff_ms.description: Initial backoff delay in milliseconds between retries (exponential).

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: Fallback policy when the primary transport is unavailable.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: If true, invoke the fallback guardrail when the primary transport fails.

fallback_guardrail_id.title: Fallback Guardrail ID
fallback_guardrail_id.description: guardrail_id of the guardrail to invoke as fallback. Its own definition governs how it is called. Should share the same behaviour.result_type as the primary guardrail.

emit_warning.title: Emit Warning
emit_warning.description: If true, emit a structured warning event to the audit log when the fallback activates.

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.description: Compiled from the Markdown body of the .guardrail.md file. Intended for the guardrail registry documentation UI.

description.title: Description
description.description: Compiled from the Markdown body. What this guardrail checks, when to use it, and known limitations.

aml_id.title: AML ID
aml_id.description: Stable, immutable AML identifier. Lowercase kebab-case. Must match ^[a-z0-9_-]{3,64}$.

error_severity_policy.title: Error Severity Policy
error_severity_policy.description: Synthetic severity returned to the agent on error. 10=equivalent to fail_closed; 0=equivalent to fail_open.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Normalized 0-10 severity value returned to the agent when this error condition occurs.

cred_none.title: Credential — none
cred_none.description: No authentication. Only valid for internal services on a fully trusted network boundary.

cred_iam_role.title: Credential — iam-role
cred_iam_role.description: Cloud-platform identity. The runtime uses the execution environment's attached identity (AWS IAM Role, GCP Workload Identity, Azure Managed Identity). No credential is stored or provisioned.

cred_api_key.title: Credential — api-key
cred_api_key.description: Static API key sent in an HTTP header. Valid for HTTP transports only (rest-api, mcp). Requires source and header; header is required with no default to avoid silent misconfiguration.

header.title: Header
header.description: HTTP header name to send the key in (e.g. X-Api-Key, Authorization).

name.title: Name
name.description: Env var name. Required when source=env.

secret_id.title: Secret ID
secret_id.description: AWS Secrets Manager secret ID. Required when source=aws_secrets_manager.

key.title: Key
key.description: Key within the secret JSON object if the secret is a JSON map.

project.title: Project
project.description: GCP project ID. Required when source=gcp_secret_manager.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: GCP secret name. Required when source=gcp_secret_manager.

vault_url.title: Vault URL
vault_url.description: Azure Key Vault URL. Required when source=azure_key_vault.

secret_name.title: Secret Name
secret_name.description: Azure Key Vault secret name. Required when source=azure_key_vault.

cred_bearer_token.title: Credential — bearer-token
cred_bearer_token.description: Bearer token sent in the Authorization: Bearer <token> header. Valid for HTTP transports only (rest-api, mcp). Requires source.

name.title: Name
name.description: Env var name. Required when source=env.

secret_id.title: Secret ID
secret_id.description: AWS Secrets Manager secret ID. Required when source=aws_secrets_manager.

key.title: Key
key.description: Key within the secret JSON object if the secret is a JSON map.

project.title: Project
project.description: GCP project ID. Required when source=gcp_secret_manager.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: GCP secret name. Required when source=gcp_secret_manager.

vault_url.title: Vault URL
vault_url.description: Azure Key Vault URL. Required when source=azure_key_vault.

secret_name.title: Secret Name
secret_name.description: Azure Key Vault secret name. Required when source=azure_key_vault.

cred_oauth2.title: Credential — oauth2
cred_oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 dynamic token via a token broker lambda on the same cloud platform. The AML runtime invokes the lambda via iam-role (no additional credential required) to obtain a fresh bearer token before each API or MCP call. The lambda owns all token lifecycle concerns: acquisition, caching, refresh, and user-delegated lookup. The runtime sends the returned access_token as Authorization: Bearer. This keeps all OAuth business logic outside AML.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Cloud provider hosting the token broker lambda. Must be the same provider as the AML runtime — invoked via iam-role with no extra credential.

function_id.title: Function ID
function_id.description: Provider-specific identifier of the token broker function. AWS: full ARN (arn:aws:lambda:…). GCP: resource name (projects/…/functions/…). Azure: resource path or function URL.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: OAuth 2.0 scopes to pass as context to the token broker lambda. Optional.

cred_service_account.title: Credential — service-account
cred_service_account.description: Explicit service identity credential stored in a secret backend and resolved at runtime. Valid for cloud transports (lambda). The resolved secret must be a JSON object containing provider-specific connection parameters (see docs for connection objects by provider). For source=env the variable value must be a stringified JSON object. Use the key field to read a sub-object within a larger secret. Contrast with iam-role: service-account means you own and store the credential; iam-role means the platform manages it.

name.title: Name
name.description: Env var name. Required when source=env. The variable value must be a stringified JSON object with provider-specific connection fields.

secret_id.title: Secret ID
secret_id.description: AWS Secrets Manager secret ID. Required when source=aws_secrets_manager.

key.title: Key
key.description: Key within the secret JSON object if the secret is a JSON map.

project.title: Project
project.description: GCP project ID. Required when source=gcp_secret_manager.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: GCP secret name. Required when source=gcp_secret_manager.

vault_url.title: Vault URL
vault_url.description: Azure Key Vault URL. Required when source=azure_key_vault.

secret_name.title: Secret Name
secret_name.description: Azure Key Vault secret name. Required when source=azure_key_vault.

credentials_http.title: Credentials (HTTP transports)
credentials_http.description: Credential schemes for HTTP-based transports (rest-api, mcp): none, api-key, bearer-token, oauth2. Cloud auth (iam-role, service-account) does not apply to HTTP transports.

credentials_cloud.title: Credentials (cloud transports)
credentials_cloud.description: Credential schemes for cloud-native transports (lambda): iam-role or service-account. HTTP-style auth does not apply to these transports.

transport_rest_api.title: Transport — rest-api
transport_rest_api.description: HTTP/REST endpoint transport. All credential schemes are supported.

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Base URL of the service. No trailing slash.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: HTTP method and path, e.g. POST /check.

transport_lambda.title: Transport — lambda
transport_lambda.description: Serverless cloud function transport (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, GCP Cloud Functions, etc.). Cloud credential schemes only.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Cloud provider running the function. aws=AWS Lambda; gcp=GCP Cloud Functions; azure=Azure Functions.

function_id.title: Function ID
function_id.description: Provider-specific identifier of the function. AWS: full ARN (arn:aws:lambda:…). Azure: resource path or function URL. GCP: resource name (projects/…/functions/…).
